Munich, Germany
One of the most recent cities in Europe I visited is Munich, München, Germany.

And I know some of you are going to be disappointed it’s not on my favorite European cities list.

I just can’t quite put it there yet.

While it was okay, I just didn’t love it.

It was a bit too busy for me.

Now, granted, I was there over a weekend and a weekend that seem to have some sort of festival or celebration going on.

I did enjoy the Viktualienmarkt with all the tasty food.

And St Peter’s Church is beautiful and its tower is cool to go up to get the views.

The Marienplatz clock tower is okay.

I know.

Some of you are like, “What?”

Again, I think it was just the crowds for me.

I’m certainly willing to visit again and see if I feel the same way.

But after being in the Black Forest then the Bavarian Alps area, Munich was simply okay.
